experiences.title: Software Engineer
experiences.description: Worked as a Full Stack Developer on enterprise security solutions in the Insurance Domain.

projects.name: Enterprise API Security Dashboard
details: Built a Java Spring Boot backend for a security dashboard surfacing vulnerability data across 3000+ APIs, replacing a slow manual search process in Traceable AI.
Developed 18 FastAPI/GraphQL endpoints to ingest data from Traceable AI and 10 Spring Boot REST APIs to serve it to an Angular dashboard.
Architected and optimized PostgreSQL data models and queries, diagnosing performance bottlenecks and reducing query latency by 40%, improving the overall reliability of data processing.
Constructed an automated notification system for 3,000+ APIs to alert owners of vulnerabilities in real time, reducing average security response time by over 24 hours.
Integrated Checkmarx static scanning into the CI pipeline, automatically catching 50+ security flaws early in the development cycle and ensuring vulnerability-free releases.
Containerized the Java and Angular applications with Docker for consistent, portable deployments across environments.
Deployed containerized services to AWS ECS with ECR as the container registry, streamlining release management.
Provisioned 3 FastAPI services using AWS SAM, reducing infrastructure deployment time by 65% and enabling automated, repeatable setup across Dev, QA, and Prod environments.
Validated APIs and workflows using SoapUI and led code reviews with QA and platform teams.
Leveraged GitHub Copilot to accelerate development, cutting boilerplate coding time and speeding up feature delivery by ~30%.

projects.name: PII Detection Agent
details: Designed and deployed a PII detection agent in Python on GCP Cloud Run using the Google ADK framework, exposing it via FastAPI and applying object-oriented design principles for a maintainable, extensible codebase.
Deployed an AWS Lambda function to process queued logs in a serverless, auto-scaling manner, applying PII detection logic and writing findings to a PostgreSQL database.
Architected a scalable, event-driven pipeline to route 50,000+ daily logs from Splunk through Apigee webhooks into an SQS queue for reliable, decoupled ingestion.
Consumed logs from SQS and batched up to 400 PII items per agent request, reducing API calls and token usage to optimize latency and cost.
Used AWS EventBridge to trigger ServiceNow incident creation with a summarized report of detected PII, closing the loop from detection to response.

Engineered structured prompts defining detection rules, expected PII categories, and output format, guiding the agent to accurately identify and classify sensitive data while minimizing false positives.
Added structured logging, error handling, and monitoring to ensure reliable, observable processing of high-volume log streams.
Documented the end-to-end system architecture using draw.io, aligning stakeholders on data flow and integration points.

experiences.title: Full-Stack Intern
experiences.description: Completed a full-stack development internship, building production-style applications and collaborating in an Agile team environment.
responsibilities: Built a full-stack Book Store application during training using a Spring Boot backend, MySQL database, and an Angular frontend with search, filter, and cart features.
Built, integrated, and tested RESTful APIs using Swagger and Postman, covering main user flows with integration tests before handoff.
Worked in an Agile team of 3, using Git/GitHub for branching, code reviews, and deployments.
